feature_definitions.monthly_income: Average monthly non-self-transfer credits over the complete 12-month reference period.
feature_definitions.avg_monthly_expenses: Average monthly non-self-transfer debits over the complete 12-month reference period.
feature_definitions.avg_monthly_emi: Average monthly EMI obligation over the complete 12-month reference period.
feature_definitions.avg_outstanding_loan: Average outstanding loan balance over the complete 12-month reference period.

limitations: Only customers with 12 distinct months are included.
Non-self-transfer credits may not capture all real income.
Cluster IDs are unsupervised groups, not credit-risk grades.
The model does not predict loan default.
Results depend on the quality and coverage of source data.
